category: Post-open, post-closure mechanism attribution; not a new predictor or acceleration
scope: Same 99 opened three-frame PoolFire train sentinels, whole-trajectory exclusion in inherited fitting, native 5/7/9 cameras; not complete sequences or untouched tests
assessment_count_boundary: Fold-train assessments reuse the 99 records across outer folds; not 990 independent samples
distance_boundary: Separate medians, not paired ratios; distance to a finite classical target, not initial CFD truth error. Image-target distance is not final observation residual.
share_boundary: Scalar-error difference decomposition, not energy fractions or unique universal causes. Values are not clipped. Preregistered near-total-explanation criterion did not pass.
interpretation: Small initial fitting improvement survives train-to-held assessment but becomes harm after fixed physical refinement. Both correction and combined exact-lift/restart tax matter. The audit does not uniquely identify a cause or authorize loss retuning.
independent_boundary: Separate unchanged refinement, physical replay, NumPy/Torch seed and loss diagnostics, fold/tail/gate/call reduction; common frozen CSR disclosed. All original states are inherited byte-identically.
cost_boundary: No new fits or teacher matvecs. Existing solver states, labels, geometry and storage remain nonfree. Audit runtime is not a fresh deployment benchmark.
